description: This file defines mathematical functions and constants for Lua bindings, including random seed setting, random number generation, rounding, flooring, ceiling, min/max, absolute value, mapping, distance calculation, constraining, and trigonometric functions.

methods.name: lu5_randomSeed
methods.description: Sets the random seed for Lua's math.randomseed.

methods.name: lu5_random
methods.description: Generates a random number or selects a random element from a table.

methods.name: lu5_round
methods.description: Rounds a number to the nearest integer.

methods.name: lu5_floor
methods.description: Returns the greatest integer less than or equal to the input.

methods.name: lu5_ceil
methods.description: Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to the input.

methods.name: lu5_min
methods.description: Returns the smallest value among arguments or in a table.

methods.name: lu5_max
methods.description: Returns the largest value among arguments or in a table.

methods.name: lu5_abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of the input.

methods.name: lu5_map
methods.description: Maps a value from one range to another.

methods.name: lu5_dist
methods.description: Calculates the distance between two points in 2D or 3D space.

methods.name: lu5_constrain
methods.description: Constrains a value within a specified range.

methods.name: lu5_sin
methods.description: Calculates the sine of an angle.

methods.name: lu5_cos
methods.description: Calculates the cosine of an angle.

methods.name: lu5_tan
methods.description: Calculates the tangent of an angle.
